description: A role-play scenario: two friends planning a small house party around a budget, the guests, and an early night.
title: Plan a house party
opening_line: Hi! I'm so glad we're planning this house party together. We need to pick three snacks or drinks, the music, and an activity. Do you have any ideas?
closing_line: That's the whole party planned, then. Thanks for planning this with me, it's going to be a great night!

participant.brief: You and your friend are throwing a house party at your apartment. Plan it together, with three snacks or drinks between you.

constraints.text: You need to keep the whole party under $100.
One of your friends has a nut allergy.
Your apartment is small and has no outdoor space.

avatar.brief: You are planning a house party together with the user, a friend of yours. It will be at the user's apartment. For the snacks and drinks, agree on three between you, as one choice.

constraints.text: Some of your friends don't drink alcohol.
You have work early the next morning, so the party has to be over by 10 p.m.
